text_block_list.text:
—February.
On the verge of spring, with the start of Zenno Rob Roy's Classic campaign just around the corner.

With the goal of "walking the royal road befitting a hero,"
she puts her heart and soul into training again today.
However—
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, about today's time...
As I thought, it hasn't really improved much, has it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have something I'd like to talk about...
I'm going to go change, so do you
have some time after this...?

Given Zenno Rob Roy's current rate of growth,
it's still hard to say she's reached her peak
compared to other Umamusume of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. But, um—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal right now is
the Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), and the Kikuka Sho...
In other words, the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Since I decided to walk the royal road, I trained assuming that's just how things would go. But..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...The Satsuki Sho.
Can I really compete?
Or rather, will I even be able to run...?"

If asked whether she can run, the answer is yes.
If we build a training regimen focused on the Satsuki Sho,
she could even contend for the win.

However, with her body not yet fully developed,
the grand stage of the Satsuki Sho places a heavy burden on her.
Is it truly right to have her exhaust all her strength here?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You've got quite a deep furrow between your brows.
It shows... just how deeply you're worrying for me."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I... gave it a lot of thought in my own way,
and finally came up with a request...
that I wanted to ask of you."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I was little...
I saw a real hero.
Though it was through the TV screen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Welcomed by a roar of cheers,
praised by all around her... the Umamusume stood proudly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I looked closely, that broadcast was the hero interview for the Nippon Derby.
Put simply, it was just a regular sports broadcast, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“To me back then, though...
it seemed like a story every bit as wonderful
as a king slaying a dragon, or a pirate crossing the seven seas.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"A once-in-a-lifetime dream"...
"Victory belongs to the one most favored by destiny"...
It's truly so dramatic, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is a story in and of itself...
That is why I saw that interview as a heroic epic.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Heroes really exist in reality. They aren't just characters in stories. That was the moment I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...So, if I am to become a hero,
then the Japanese Derby must be written
into my story."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To catch up to the heroic tale I saw that day... to the story I longed for—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
The setting sun streaming through the window cast a faint red glow over Zenno Rob Roy's face.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I want to win the Derby.
—It was a look of pure determination.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't want to look at the Derby simply as one of the GⅠs on the path to the Triple Crown...
I just want to aim for the Derby itself."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's why... I won't make the Satsuki Sho my goal.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Um, wh-what do you think...?

"Aiming for the Satsuki Sho in this state is certainly scary.
There's the risk of injury, the strain, and the mental toll of losing."

Risks accompany any race, but for Zenno Rob Roy,
whose body has not yet fully matured, it poses an even
greater concern. However—
choice_data_list: Still, betting everything on just the Derby is a huge risk.

text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Derby with so little graded race experience
would be unrealistic.
I told her we needed a stepping-stone race to aim for...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Then how about the Aoba Sho?

...It seemed Zenno Rob Roy had arrived
at the exact same conclusion.

The Aoba Sho is held at the same racecourse and over the same distance as the Japanese Derby.
It's the ideal prep race.

"While I haven't completely given up on the Satsuki Sho,
I believe this is the best move for now.
However..."
choice_data_list: But it's a road no one's ever conquered before.
But it's a road no one's ever conquered before, you know.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...No Umamusume has ever won
the Nippon Derby coming from the Aoba Sho.
It's a fairly well-known fact, you know."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Even so, that's precisely why... if we win, um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Don't you think it's cool?

Coolness—even while understanding that isn't the sole
reason, I couldn't help but chuckle.
Still, I thought that was perfectly fine.
choice_data_list: After all, this is your story.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best, so...
Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This heroic tale...
probably isn't *my* story, you know."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking...
I hope it turns out to be a story of "the two of us"—Trainer-san and me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Th-That's kind of embarrassing...!
I'm sorry for getting
all hyped up on my own...!

The Aoba Sho—
Having chosen the royal road to follow,
Zenno Rob Roy turns yet another page.
—A new page in "their" story.
